description: Capabilities for the AccessibleAudioStudio Pro main window. Almost the entire app calls no Tauri commands at all — microphone access, recording, playback, and storage are all standard web APIs (getUserMedia, MediaRecorder, IndexedDB) handled by the WebView2 runtime, not Tauri IPC. Open Audio is the one exception, via a single custom command (pick_and_read_audio_files, see src-tauri/src/main.rs) that does the native file picking and file reading entirely in Rust. Custom app commands registered via invoke_handler are allowed by default for every window under core:default — no plugin-specific permission entry is needed for it. As of 0.1.4 this app no longer calls the dialog or fs plugins' own JS-exposed commands directly, so no dialog:* or fs:* permissions are granted here.
